name: waynestate/sesame
description: Wayne State's protocol-neutral auth library: it returns a verified identity and leaves the session to the app.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: A PSR-18 client for the cas, oauth2 and oidc drivers
suggest.league/oauth2-client: Required by the oidc driver (browser sign-in to Entra): the authorization code flow with PKCE and the token request
suggest.onelogin/php-saml: Required by the saml driver (a SAML 2.0 service provider for a Shibboleth-style IdP): ^4.3.2
suggest.promphp/prometheus_client_php: Required by the sign-in counter (sesame_logins_total); HELMET already requires it
suggest.symfony/http-client: A PSR-18 client for the cas, oauth2 and oidc drivers
suggest.waynestate/playbook: WSU's shared values (CAS, Entra, gateway); private, git.wayne.edu

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: validate the manifest, run the tests, lint with Pint, analyse with PHPStan, check the setting sync, check the agent-ready files, check the docs site, and audit the locked dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.setting:check: Fail when src/Support/Setting.php, the shared part of docs/guides/wsu-values.md, or setting-sync.json drifts from Playbook's bin/setting-sync.php.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site from docs/ into site/docs/ (Squire's docs builder): render the pages, fill the generated environment reference, and stamp the current version.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when the built docs site is stale or the generated environment reference has drifted from the source.
